talk.jaymoskingdoms.mourning.rite.1: Help me with %s. They shouldn't lie out here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.mourning.rite.2: Easy now. We'll put %s somewhere quiet.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.mourning.rite.3: Earth over you, %s, and nothing to trouble you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.mourning.grief.1: I keep thinking %s will get back up.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.mourning.grief.3: Rest, %s. We'll carry on for you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.mourning.tale.1: I travelled with %s, %s. We got into more trouble than I'll ever tell. I buried them myself.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.mourning.tale.2: Adventures? There was %s. That was %s. They'd have liked you. They're under a stone now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.mourning.tale.3: The last one I followed was %s, %s. I still wake up thinking we're on the road.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.mourning.tale.4: %s and I saw half the world together, %s. I said the words over them when it ended.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.mourning.you_remind: You've something of them about you. Strange.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.smog.curious.0: Is something burning? It's coming off you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.smog.curious.1: That cough of yours doesn't sound like any cold I know.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.smog.curious.2: You've ash all over you. Been sleeping in a chimney?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.smog.curious.3: Your breath smells like a forge gone bad.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.smog.knowing.0: That's no hearth smoke. That's the rot that eats people from the inside.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.smog.knowing.1: Nobody ends up breathing that filth by chance. What did you do to deserve it?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.smog.knowing.2: My grandmother said the black smoke only takes those who've earned it. Keep away from my children.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.smog.knowing.3: People are talking about you. The smoke, the coughing. Whatever's in you, we don't want it here.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.smog.out.0: Out! Take your poison somewhere else!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.smog.out.1: We've seen enough. You're not welcome here. Go!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.smog.out.2: Whatever wickedness brought that smoke on you, it isn't staying in our town.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.smog.out.3: Get out before you choke the lot of us!
message.jaymoskingdoms.smog.last_warning: %s has had enough of the smoke on you. One more time and they'll throw you out.
message.jaymoskingdoms.smog.driven_out: %s has driven you out for the corruption on you. Stay away for %s minutes.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.errands.ask: What can I do for you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.errands.plot_build: Choose what goes up on my plot
talk.jaymoskingdoms.errands.courier: Have what I'm holding carried to someone
talk.jaymoskingdoms.errands.courier_none: There's nobody about to carry %s to.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.revive.necromancer: A lock of mane. I can call it back from where it went. %s, and it walks again. Don't expect it to be the horse you buried.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.revive.wizard_warn: Put that away. What comes back isn't what died. It runs slower, it tires sooner, and it never quite settles, and under a red moon it can turn into something else. Let it rest.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.revive.wizard_task: Then show me you mean it. Bring me %2$s ×%1$s and I'll teach you the rite myself. I won't do it for you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.revive.wizard_known: You know the rite already. Hold the lock and speak it. And remember what I told you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.revive.poor: You can't pay what the necromancer asks.
message.jaymoskingdoms.revive.taught: The wizard teaches you the rite of return. Use a mane lock to raise its horse.
message.jaymoskingdoms.revive.failed: Nothing answers. Whatever this lock belonged to can't come back.
message.jaymoskingdoms.revive.raised: %s stands up again. It isn't quite the same.
message.jaymoskingdoms.revive.mutated.ni: Under the blood moon, %s burns into a Nightmare.
message.jaymoskingdoms.revive.mutated.ba: Under the blood moon, %s grows leather wings. It's a Bat Horse now.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.bout.title: The school bout of %s
gui.jaymoskingdoms.bout.ready_ask: Your next fighter is waiting. The round starts when you say you're ready.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hard.cast.no_map: You don't know these lands yet. There's nothing on your map.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.speak_with_d: A Death Sorcerer asks the body they look at, and the dead answer: who they were, how they died, and who killed them. You know their name after.
message.jaymoskingdoms.death.speak_not_y: Only a Death Sorcerer can make the dead speak.
message.jaymoskingdoms.death.speak_silen: The dead won't answer. Whoever this was, they're too far gone to call back.
relief.jaymoskingdoms.trapped.call: Help! I'm shut in under the stones! Is anyone there?
relief.jaymoskingdoms.trapped.freed: Light! Oh, thank the gods. I thought they'd find my bones in there.
relief.jaymoskingdoms.trapped.neighbours: My neighbours dug me out at last. A day and a night in the dark, and nobody else came.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.trapped.quak: The quake brought the stones down on %1$s. We can hear them calling, but we haven't the strength to shift it all. Dig them out, near %3$s, %4$s, before the rest of it comes down on them!
message.jaymoskingdoms.rust_storm.warn.h: "The stars over Rustfall have gone the colour of old blood. A rust storm is gathering there. Whatever lives in it will be mad with it, so don't be out on that world when it breaks."
"Smell that? Iron on the wind. A rust storm is coming, and the beasts here go mad in it. Find cover, or be ready."
message.jaymoskingdoms.rust_storm.warn.p: "Patrol advisory: a rust storm front is building over Rustfall. Hostiles out there get a lot meaner while it blows. Delay any landing if you can."
"Heads up, the front's almost on us. Rust storm inbound. Everything with teeth gets meaner while it blows, so stay sharp."
